e7d0-9609-a2f8-1970.text: When a Weapon with this Special Rule is selected to make Attacks during the Declare Weapons and Set Initiative Step of the Fight Sub-Phase, all Models with the Skitarii Trait that are part of the same Unit as the Model with the Weapon with this Special Rule immediately recover from Pinned, Suppressed and Stunned.

4cd3-8bb8-3e73-42b4.name: Subterranean
4cd3-8bb8-3e73-42b4.text:
"Shooting Attacks made using a Weapon with this Special Rule interact with Cover Saves, Shrouded Damage Mitigation Rolls, Armour Facings, the Flyer Sub-Type and Levels differently to typical Shooting Attacks."


The following effects are conferred onto any Weapon with this Special Rule:
- A Cover Save or Shrouded Damage Mitigation Roll may bot be made to discard a wound or Penetrating Hit inflicted by a Weapon with this Special Rule, but Armour Saves or Invulnerable Saves may be made as normal.
- Hits inflicted by a Weapon with this Special Rule against Vehicles always count as targeting that Vehicle's Side Armour facing.
- A Weapon with this Special Rule may never be used to target a Model with the Flyer Sub-Type.
- When targeting a Unit containing Models which are inside area terrain which has multiple levels, Hits inflicted by a Weapon with this Special Rule may never be allocated to Models on any level other than the lowest level.

2f86-3286-d05e-f297.name: Sire of the White Scars
2f86-3286-d05e-f297.text:
If a model with this Special Rule is part of an Army, then the Controlling Player may apply the following additional Special Rules to all Auxiliary, Apex, and Primary Detachments that have the same Faction Trait as the Model with this Special Rule:
- If four or more Troops Battlefield Role Slots in the Primary Detachment of this Army are filled then any Transport Battlefield Role Slots in the Primary Detachment may be exchanged for Recon Battlefield Role Slots. Any Recon Battlefield Role Slots included in the Primary Detachment in this way must be filled with Land Raider Explorator Units.


Furthermore, if a Model with this Special Rule is part of an Army, then the following Special Rules are granted to all Models with the Infantry and Primarch Type with the White Scars Trait in the same Army:
- Until the end of the first Battle Turn of a Battle, all models in this Army with the Infantry or Paragon Type and the White Scars Trait have the Fast (2) special rule.

da8b-ef22-b3d8-b966.name: Death by a Thousand Cuts
da8b-ef22-b3d8-b966.text: While a Model with this Special Rule is engaged in a Challenge, the Controlling Player can select the "Death by a Thousand Cuts" Gambit.

5ca6-854b-4dd6-efa7.name: Chosen of the Khagan
5ca6-854b-4dd6-efa7.text: Once per Battle, at the start of the Reserves Sub-Phase of the Movement Phase, this Model's Controlling Player may select a single Unit which only includes Models with the White Scars Trait that is in Reserves. Reserve Rolls made for that Unit during this Sub-Phase are automatically successful.

998a-db76-ca15-6ff1.name: Seeker of Atonement
998a-db76-ca15-6ff1.text: While a Model with this Special Rule is engaged in a Challenge, the Controlling Player can select the "Seeker of Atonment" Gambit.

47ba-ec7d-9761-6876.name: Invocation of the Razing Tempest
47ba-ec7d-9761-6876.text:
"A Unit that includes any Models with this Special Rule can be more easily selected as the target of the Call of the
Wind Psychic Power."
A Unit that includes any Models with this Special Rule may be selected as the target of the Call of the Wind Psychic Power from the Stormcalling Discipline while it has at least one Model within 24" of the Focus instead of 12". In addition, a Unit that includes any Models with this Special Rule may be selected as the Target of that Psychic Power even if no Models in that Unit have Line of Sight to the Focus.

a5ea-6080-f967-4d04.name: Proof of Valour
a5ea-6080-f967-4d04.text:
"Hit Tests resolved for Models with a Weapon Skill of 5 against a Unit entirely composed of Models with this Special Rule are only successful on a 4+"


For any Strike Group in which the attacking Combatants have a current Weapon Skill Characteristic of 5, the Target Number of any Hit Test resulting from that Strike Group is always 4+ if that Strike Group's Target is entirely composed of Models with this Special Rule.

7557-938d-f2fb-6cfa.name: Swift of Action
7557-938d-f2fb-6cfa.text:
"The White Scars Player may increase their Model's Movement Characteristic."


At the start of any of the Controlling Player's Turns that Player may choose to increase the movement Characteristic of any Model with this Special Rule and a Base Movement Characteristic of at least 1 and apply a modifier of +2 to that Characteristic until the end of that Player Turn.

3f98-81ce-1608-51fc.name: The Power of the Word
3f98-81ce-1608-51fc.text: A Model with this Special Rule can join Units with the Malefic Sub-Type as if it had that Sub-Type and while part of such a Unit, is treated as having that Sub-Type

25e7-a4a9-887a-d8ed.name: Sire of the Word Bearers
25e7-a4a9-887a-d8ed.text:
If a Model with this Special Rule is part of an Army, then the Controlling Player may apply the following additional Special Rules to all Auxiliary, Apex and Primary Detachments that have the same Faction Trait as the Model with this Special Rule:


- If four or more Troops Battlefield Role Slots in the Primary Detachment of this Army are filled with Despoiler Squad Units and/or Tactical Squad Units, then all Force Organisation Slots with Troops Battlefield Role in the Primary Detachment are considered Prime Slots.


Furthermore, if a Model with this Special Rule is part of an Army, then the following Special Rules are granted to all Models with the Word Bearers Trait in the same Army:


- Until the end of the first Battle Turn of the Battle, each time the Controlling Player of a Model with this Special Rule is required to make a Leadership Check for a Unit that includes only Models with the Word Bearers Trait, that Leadership Check is automatically passed.

fe99-0874-2c10-cba5.name: Unwavering Conviction
fe99-0874-2c10-cba5.text:
"Word Bearers gain additional Combat Resolution Points."


When resolving a Combat in the Resolution Sub-Phase of the Assault Phase, score 1 Combat Resolution point if any friendly Models in that Combat have the Word Bearers Trait.

898b-36fe-df6b-50a3.name: Dark Oratory
898b-36fe-df6b-50a3.text:
"Kor Phaeron's Controlling Player may apply additional Special Rules to friendly Units in the Effects Sub-Phase."


In this Model's Controlling Player's Effects Sub-Phase, this Model's Controlling Player can select one friendly Unit which only includes Models with the Word Bearers Trait within 6" of this Model, then select one of the following effects.


- Cruel Invective: Until the start of the Controlling Player's next Effects Sub-Phase, all Models in the selected Unit gain the Hatred (Loyalist) Special Rule.
- Threatening Entreaties: Until the start of the Controlling Player's next Effects Sub-Phase, modify the Leadership and Cool Characteristics of all Models in the selected Unit by +2.

ee29-139a-6af2-f75d.name: Jealous Command
ee29-139a-6af2-f75d.text:
"Kor Phaeron's Characteristics increase if he is the only Unique Model in the Army.


If this Model is the only Model with the Unique Sub-Type in your Army, modify this Model's Wounds and Leadership Characteristics by +1.

ee53-dde6-9800-a3b9.name: Lord of the Blessed
ee53-dde6-9800-a3b9.text: A Model with this Special Rule can join Units with the Malefic Sub-Type as if it had that Sub-Type and while part of such a Unit, is treated as having that Sub-Type.

6f98-3b19-41a2-58ae.name: Harbinger of Chaos
6f98-3b19-41a2-58ae.text: An Army whose Primary Detachment includes a Model with this Special Rule may select Demonic Manifestation Auxiliary Detachments regardless of how many Command Force Organisation Slots are filled with Esoterist Units.

0795-59f5-4d5e-d30b.name: Binder of Souls
0795-59f5-4d5e-d30b.text:
"Zardu Layak has specific Psychic Powers."


A Model with this Special Rule gains the Soul Binding Psychic Power and the Breach the Veil Psychic Power.

328f-f751-232c-7b3d.name: The Panoply of Flame
328f-f751-232c-7b3d.text: When resolving a Combat in the Resolution Sub-Phase of the Assault Phase, score 1 Combat Resolution point for the Unit that includes a Model with the Panoply of Flame.

742c-a99a-3b4e-95d6.name: Harbingers of Truth
742c-a99a-3b4e-95d6.text:
"Ashen Circle improves the Firepower Characteristic of Akkadic hand flamers in the Volley Step."


When a Model with this Special Rule makes Volley Attacks, modify the Firepower Characteristic of that Model's Akkadic hand flamer by +1.

6786-5026-73bb-ee16.name: Damned
6786-5026-73bb-ee16.text:
"A Model with this Special Rule can join Units that have the Malefic Sub-Type."
A Model with this Special Rule can join Units with the Malefic Sub-Type as if it had that Sub-Type and while part of such a Unit, is treated as having that Sub-Type.

7b46-599c-9ffb-34ff.name: Flesh Harvester
7b46-599c-9ffb-34ff.text:
A Model with this Special Rule can gain Flesh Harvest Points. A Model with this Special Rule gains 1 Flesh Harvest point each time a Unit that includes that Model is selected to Consolidate, if any enemy Models in that Combat had the Infantry or Cavalry Type. If a Model with the Paragon Type was Removed as a Casualty during that Combat, the Model with this Special Rule gains 2 Flesh Harvest Points instead.


If a Model with any Flesh Harvest Points is Removed as a Casualty, any Flesh Harvest Points that Model has are lost. During the Decide Victor Step, at the end of the Battle, the Controlling Player of any Models with the Flesh Harvester Special Rule scores a number of Victory Points equal to the number of Flesh Harvest Points that any one of those Models, selected by the Controlling Player, currently has.

0fea-09cd-9274-225a.name: Empty Vessels
0fea-09cd-9274-225a.text:
"A Unit containing any Models with this Special Rule gains the Malefic Sub-Type and the Feel No Pain (6+) Special Rule once it scores Victory Points due to the Vanguard (X) Special Rule, after suffering D3 wounds."




A Unit containing Models with this Special Rule may never be joined by a Model without this Special Rule. Additionally, the first time in a Battle each Unit which includes Models with this Special Rule scores Victory Points due to the Vanguard (X) Special Rule, that Unit immediately suffers D3 automatic wounds with an AP of 2 and a Damage of 1 against which no Saving Throws of any kind may be made. Once these wounds are resolved, every Model in that Unit immediately gains the Malefic Sub-Type and the Feel No Pain (6+) Special Rule for the remainder of the Battle.

1a45-676f-f623-3057.name: Sire of the World Eaters
1a45-676f-f623-3057.text:
If a Model with this Special Rule is part of an Army, then the Controlling Player may apply the following additional Special Rules to all Auxiliary, Apex and Primary Detachments that have the same Faction Trait as the Model with this Special Rule:


• If four or more Troops Battlefield Role Slots in the Primary Detachment of this Army are filled with Assault Squad and/or Despoiler Squad Units, then all Force Organisation Slots with the Troops Battlefield Role in the Primary Detachment are considered Prime Slots.


Furthermore, if a Model with this Special Rule is part of an Army, then the following Special Rules are granted to all Models with the Infantry and Paragon Type with the World Eaters Trait in the same Army:


• Until the end of the first Battle Turn of the Battle, all Models in this Army with the Infantry or Paragon Type and the World Eaters Trait have the Fast (2) Special Rule.

4d8f-2418-1155-ddcd.name: Level-headed
4d8f-2418-1155-ddcd.text:
"A Unit that Lotara Sarrin has joined may use her Characteristics to remove Tactical Statuses."

If a Unit includes a Model with this Special Rule, during the Start Phase of their Turn as the Active Player the Controlling Player may make a Check to remove a single Status from all Models in the Unit that includes the Model with this Special Rule. This Check is made using the Characteristics of the Model with this Special Rule (using Cool, unless attempting to remove Routed, in which case Leadership is used).

2f7a-625e-ad4e-c62c.name: Shadow of the Conquerer
2f7a-625e-ad4e-c62c.text:
If a Model with this Special Rule is included in the Primary Detachment of this Army and is on the Battlefield, in the Effects Sub-Phase of the Start Phase, the Controlling Player of the Model with this Special Rule can make an Intelligence Check for that Model. If that Check is successful, the Controlling Player can select one of the Following options:


• Coordinate: Once during this Turn, before making a Reserves Test for a Unit in Aerial Reserves, the Controlling Player can modify the result of that Reserves Test by +1.
• Annihilate: Once during their opponent's next Movement Phase, the Controlling Player can make the Guns of the Conqueror Advanced Reaction.

5d1c-eac1-71fe-e5b8.name: Lord of Corruption
5d1c-eac1-71fe-e5b8.text: Angron Transfigured cannot be included in the same Army as Angron.

781d-9aa5-72fc-42e7.name: Chain-brothers
781d-9aa5-72fc-42e7.text: While a Model with this Special Rule is within Unit Coherency of the other Model from your Army with this Special Rule, that Model gains a bonus of +1 to Hit Tests made in the Assault Phase. If a Model that is engaged in a Challenge is in the same Combat as the other Model from your Army with this Special Rule, that Model is treated as being in Unit Coherency  with that other Model for the purposes of this Special Rule.

25ad-1ab4-b33a-9391.name: Chain-bonded
25ad-1ab4-b33a-9391.text: This Prime Advantage can only be selected once per Army. When this Prime Advantage is selected, the Controlling Player must select another Unit which only includes Models with the World Eaters Trait that has the Command Battlefield Role from their Army. One Model in the selected Unit and one Model in the Unit selected to fill a Prime Force Organisation Slot with this Prime Advantage both gain the Chain-brothers Special Rule.

0264-f73a-e487-91eb.name: Bearers of the Blood Hand
0264-f73a-e487-91eb.text: When resolving a Combat in the Resolution Sub-Phase of the Assault Phase, the Controlling Player scores 1 Combat Resolution Point for each Unit that includes any Models with this Special Rule.

bc60-0902-c013-18ae.name: Bearers of the Blood Hand
bc60-0902-c013-18ae.text: When resolving a Combat in the Resolution Sub-Phase of the Assault Phase, the Controlling Player scores 1 Combat Resolution Point for each Unit that includes any Models with this Special Rule.

7b8c-068a-9985-9b71.name: The Nails' Bite
7b8c-068a-9985-9b71.text:
"The Controlling Player may choose that a World Eaters Unit becomes Lost to the Nails when it fails a Leadership Check"
When a Unit entirely composed of Models with this Special Rule fails a Leadership Check, that Unit's Controlling Player can choose for that Unit to become Lost to the Nails.

b0e3-2944-982a-e8c4.name: Lost to the Nails
b0e3-2944-982a-e8c4.text:
When a Unit becomes Lost to the Nails, all Tactical Statuses affecting it are removed. In addition, while a Unit is Lost to the Nails:


- Models in that Unit may add +1" to the distance of any Set-up Move.
- Modify the Attacks Characteristic of Models in that Unit by +1.
- Models in that Unit are considered to have a Leadership, Cool and Willpower Characteristic of 10 (unless it would normally be higher).
- If at the start of the Controlling Player's Charge Sub-Phase, the Unit is within 12" of any enemy Models, that Unit must make a Charge Move. If more than one enemy Unit is within 12", the Controlling Player of this Unit must select the closest enemy Unit as the Target Unit for that Charge.


At the start of the Controlling Player's Charge Sub-Phase, if there are no enemy Units within 12" of a Unit that is Lost to the Nails, that Unit is no longer Lost to the Nails.

b891-bc7e-86a4-203c.name: Violence Incarnate
b891-bc7e-86a4-203c.text:
"World Eaters gain a +1 to their Attacks Characteristic when they Charge."

On any Turn in which they made a Charge Move, Models with this Special Rule modify their Attacks Characteristic by +1 until the end of the Phase.

262c-556a-b346-4253.name: Chain-brothers
262c-556a-b346-4253.text: While a Model with this Special Rule is within Unit Coherency of the other Model from your Army with this Special Rule, that Model gains a bonus of +1 to Hit Tests made in the Assault Phase. If a Model that is engaged in a Challenge is in the same Combat as the other Model from your Army with this Special Rule, that Model is treated as being in Unit Coherency  with that other Model for the purposes of this Special Rule.

b20c-76b7-0109-ebd7.name: Chain-bonded
b20c-76b7-0109-ebd7.text: This Prime Advantage can only be selected once per Army. When this Prime Advantage is selected, the Controlling Player must select another Unit which only includes Models with the World Eaters Trait that has the Command Battlefield Role from their Army. One Model in the selected Unit and one Model in the Unit selected to fill a Prime Force Organisation Slot with this Prime Advantage both gain the Chain-brothers Special Rule.

e498-058b-f7ab-f88a.name: Minoris
e498-058b-f7ab-f88a.text: Do not increase the BS Characteristic of this Model's Arms Profile or Carapace Profile

c80b-57c3-e1d3-3511.name: Senoris
c80b-57c3-e1d3-3511.text: Increase the BS Characteristic of this Model’s Arms Profile and Carapace Profile to 4

c5d5-dcbf-2d51-adec.name: Majoris
c5d5-dcbf-2d51-adec.text: Increase the BS Characteristic of this Model’s Arms Profile and Carapace Profile to 5

dcb6-3210-cd5a-9d00.name: The Attacker Asset Trait
dcb6-3210-cd5a-9d00.text: Battlefield Assets with the Attacker Trait may only be selected by the Player taking that role in the Mission being played.

ad11-1191-3191-7509.name: The Defender Asset Trait
ad11-1191-3191-7509.text: Battlefield Assets with the Defender Trait may only be selected by the Player taking that role in the Mission being played.

1d82-cb03-376e-f062.name: The Minefield Asset Trait
1d82-cb03-376e-f062.text: A Battlefield Asset with the Minefield Trait must be set up with the centre of the Marker anywhere on the Battlefield that is more than 6" from the centre of any other Battlefield Asset Markers with the Minefield Asset Trait, and not within an opponent's Deployment Zone.

29af-b990-5cfb-cf20.name: The Explosive Asset Trait
29af-b990-5cfb-cf20.text: If a Blast Marker covers the centre of a Battlefield Asset Marker with the Explosive Asset Trait, then after that Shooting Attack has been resolved, the Controlling Player of the Unit making the Shooting Attack must roll one Dice. On a 4+, every Unit within 6" of the centre of that Battlefield Asset Marker suffers a number of hits equal to the Asset Points cost of that Marker. Each such hit has a Strength of 8, an AP of '-', a Damage of 1, and the Breaching (5+) and Shred (5+) Special Rules.

23f1-5b3b-34ec-db8a.name: Legion Specialists
23f1-5b3b-34ec-db8a.text: If Models in this Unit would benefit from the Mutable Tactics Legion Tactica, they may only benefit from the bonus related to their Legion whose Trait was replaced as part of this Prime Advantage.
